Commune with Dinosaurs.oracle_text: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a Dinosaur or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

Cultivate.oracle_text: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, reveal those cards, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.

Drover of the Mighty.oracle_text:
This creature gets +2/+2 as long as you control a Dinosaur.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.

Fleeting Distraction.oracle_text:
Target creature gets -1/-0 until end of turn.
Draw a card.

Gonti, Lord of Luxury.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
When Gonti enters, look at the top four cards of target opponent's library, exile one of them face down, then put the rest on the bottom of that library in a random order. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.

Instruments of War.oracle_text:
Flash
As this artifact enters, choose a creature type.
Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1.

Lawless Broker.oracle_text: When this creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

Mausoleum Turnkey.oracle_text: When this creature enters, return target creature card of an opponent's choice from your graveyard to your hand.

Nocturnal Feeder.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature dies, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.

Scion Summoner.oracle_text:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
When this creature enters, create a 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature token. It has "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}." ({C} represents colorless mana.)

Setessan Training.oracle_text:
Enchant creature you control
When this Aura enters, draw a card.
Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 and has trample. (It can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)

Spellstutter Sprite.oracle_text:
Flash
Flying
When this creature enters, counter target spell with mana value X or less, where X is the number of Faeries you control.

Thieves' Guild Enforcer.oracle_text:
Flash
Whenever this creature or another Rogue you control enters, each opponent mills two cards.
As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, this creature gets +2/+1 and has deathtouch.

Thrashing Brontodon.oracle_text: {1}, Sacrifice this creature: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.

Thriving Grove.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than green.
{T}: Add {G} or one mana of the chosen color.

Titan's Presence.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, reveal a colorless creature card from your hand.
Exile target creature if its power is less than or equal to the revealed card's power.

Unnatural Aggression.oracle_text:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
Target creature you control fights target creature an opponent controls. If the creature an opponent controls would die this turn, exile it instead.

Wavebreak Hippocamp.oracle_text: Whenever you cast your first spell during each opponent's turn, draw a card.

annotations.description: Kimi25 passed on casting Spellstutter Sprite at end of opponent's turn despite being severely mana-screwed with only 2 lands and 8 cards in hand. The 2 mana goes completely to waste. The Sprite would provide a 1/1 flying body for attacking/blocking, and is a Rogue that synergizes with Thieves' Guild Enforcer. Holding it to counter a spell is low-value since with only 1 Faerie it can only counter MV ≤1 spells.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, wasting 2 mana at end of opponent's turn
annotations.betterLine: Cast Spellstutter Sprite at end of opponent's turn to get a 1/1 flyer on board, providing chip damage, a potential blocker, and Rogue synergy with Thieves' Guild Enforcer, rather than wasting 2 mana while severely mana-screwed

annotations.description: Declined to flash in Spellstutter Sprite as a blocker during combat, taking 6 damage (going to 10) instead of blocking the 4/4 Thrashing Brontodon to save 4 life (going to 14) or the 2/2 Scion Summoner to trade and save 2 life. At only 2 lands with a terrible board position, every point of life matters. The Sprite's counter ability is very narrow (MV ≤1 with no other Faeries) so saving it for that purpose has low expected value.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, taking 6 damage from Scion Summoner and Thrashing Brontodon.
annotations.betterLine: Flash in Spellstutter Sprite to block Thrashing Brontodon, saving 4 life and only taking 2 damage from Scion Summoner. The 1/1 flying body is worth less than 4 life in this dire board position.

annotations.description: At 10 life facing 6 damage from Scion Summoner (2/2) and Thrashing Brontodon (4/4 trample), declining to flash in Spellstutter Sprite to block Scion Summoner costs 2 life (going to 4 instead of 6). With the opponent's board growing (Warden of Geometries coming online next turn), every life point matters. The Sprite as a 1/1 isn't going to meaningfully contribute later given the massive board disadvantage and mana screw.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, taking the full 6 damage to go to 4 life.
annotations.betterLine: Flash in Spellstutter Sprite to block Scion Summoner, saving 2 life and going to 6 instead of 4. With only 2 Islands and a stacked hand requiring more mana, survival is the priority.

annotations.description: At 10 life with no board presence facing 12+ power of attackers, casting Fleeting Distraction for a cantrip and minor -1/-0 instead of deploying Spellstutter Sprite as a chump blocker is risky. The 1/1 flyer could absorb 2-4 damage next combat, which is critical at 10 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Fleeting Distraction to draw a card and give -1/-0
annotations.betterLine: Cast Spellstutter Sprite to get a 1/1 flying body on board as a chump blocker, since surviving the next attack is the immediate priority at 10 life with no blockers.

annotations.description: Activated Thrashing Brontodon's sacrifice ability to destroy their own Setessan Training - the only artifact/enchantment on the battlefield. This destroys their own enchantment AND sacrifices their biggest creature (4/4 with trample) for zero benefit. The opponent has no artifacts or enchantments. The opponent is at 10 life with all lands tapped and only a sick 1/1, so attacking with the full board (3/3 + 2/2 + 4/4 trample + 1/1 + 2/3 = 12+ damage) could have been lethal or near-lethal.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Thrashing Brontodon to sacrifice it and destroy their own Setessan Training.
annotations.betterLine: Skip to combat and attack with all or most creatures. With opponent at 10 life, all lands tapped, and only a sick 1/1 blocker, attacking with Drover (3/3), Scion Summoner (2/2), Brontodon (4/4 trample), Eldrazi Scion (1/1), and Warden (2/3) would deal at minimum 11+ damage for lethal.

annotations.description: Cast Unnatural Aggression to remove Nocturnal Feeder when the player already had lethal on board with 12 power of attackers against an opponent at 4 life with no available blockers (Nocturnal Feeder is summoning sick, all opponent lands tapped). This wastes a card for no benefit.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Unnatural Aggression to fight and exile Nocturnal Feeder before combat.
annotations.betterLine: Skip straight to combat and attack with all creatures for 12 damage against 4 life with no blockers available. No need to spend a card removing the only opposing creature that can't even block.
